up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Who is this King of glory? The
, do I lift up my soul.
O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

items.text: Who [is] this—“the King of Glory?” YHWH—strong and mighty, || YHWH, the mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O gates! And be lifted up, O perpetual doors! And the King of Glory comes in!
Who [is] He—this “King of Glory?” YHWH of hosts—He [is] the King of Glory! Selah.
BY DAVID. [ALEPH-BET] To You, O YHWH, I lift up my soul.
My God, in You I have trusted, || Do not let me be ashamed, || Do not let my enemies exult over me.
Also let none waiting on You be ashamed, || Let the treacherous dealers without cause be ashamed.
Your ways, O YHWH, cause me to know, || You teach me Your paths.
